subject.title: feat: session menu adds Open PR, Open in editor, and numbered group shortcuts

question: Should session-menu editor opening be deferred, restricted by an explicit same-host capability, or routed to the host that owns the managed worktree?
rationale: Custom editor URL schemes execute on the browser machine while the path comes from the gateway, and current code exposes no reliable contract proving those machines share a filesystem.

options.title: Split out editor opening
options.body: Land Open PR and numeric shortcuts while deferring editor handoff until host ownership is represented explicitly.

options.title: Add same-host capability
options.body: Retain editor opening only when a trusted capability proves the browser machine owns the gateway checkout path.

options.title: Route to owning host
options.body: Introduce a host-aware editor command that executes where the managed worktree resides.

recommendation.title: Split out editor opening
recommendation.body: Land Open PR and numeric shortcuts while deferring editor handoff until host ownership is represented explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant session-menu, PR-detection, and editor-opening surfaces trace most strongly to his recent merged Control UI work.
